notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Eerie Interlude by paying {2}{W}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Eerie Interlude.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.
